name: Magistrate Solomon
summary: Magistrate Solomon is the elected ruler and chief magistrate of Lakeshire, presiding over local affairs from the town hall. Besieged by Blackrock orcs and relentless gnoll clans, he spends his days frantically pleading for military aid from an indifferent and distracted Stormwind.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon governs Lakeshire during the darkest hour in its recent history. The tranquil lakeside settlement is surrounded by hostility: Redridge and Shadowhide gnolls prowl the surrounding hills, while Blackrock orcs descend from the north in organized warbands. Solomon works alongside Marshal Marris to maintain civil order and muster a defense, but Lakeshire's local guards and militia are stretched to their absolute breaking point.

sections.title: Appeals to Deaf Ears
sections.body: Desperate to secure reinforcements, Solomon has dispatched messengers across the kingdom—pleading for aid from Westfall, Darkshire, and the capital of Stormwind itself. His petitions have yielded bitter disappointment. Westfall struggles under the grip of the Defias Brotherhood, Duskwood is consumed by its own creeping terrors, and Stormwind City refuses to deploy troops to the eastern frontier, leaving Lakeshire entirely to its own devices.

sections.title: The Court's Refusal
sections.body: When evidence emerges that the Blackrock orcs are allied with the black dragonflight, Solomon forwards the warning straight to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Despite the magnitude of the threat, royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor dismisses Solomon's pleas as wild exaggeration. Constrained by her counsel and Stormwind's thinly spread forces, Bolvar declines to commit the Stormwind Army, offering Solomon only royal sanction to deputize independent mercenaries.

faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon is the elected civil leader of Lakeshire and presiding judge of the Court of Lakeshire. Operating from the town hall, he oversees local administrative matters and orchestrates the town's desperate defense against invading gnolls and orcs.

faq.q: Why can't Stormwind send troops to help him?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is already stretched thin across several troubled regions. When Solomon appeals for aid, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is heavily influenced by royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor, who questions Solomon's reports and actively discourages committing regular kingdom troops to Redridge.

faq.q: Did Ironforge try to send help?
faq.answer: Yes. At Solomon's plea, King Magni Bronzebeard dispatched a relief contingent headed by Princess Moira Bronzebeard. However, the expedition never made it to Redridge, having been ambushed and captured in the Burning Steppes.

Lakeshire faces simultaneous pressure from the Redridge and Shadowhide gnolls who terrorize the hills and roads, as well as the aggressive Blackrock orcs raiding south from Stonewatch Keep and the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: Who works with Solomon to defend the town?
faq.answer: Solomon coordinates primarily with Marshal Marris, who directs the local town guard. Because regular reinforcements never arrive, the two officials are forced to enlist and deputize traveling adventurers to push back the encroaching threats.

faq.q: Why does Solomon send couriers to Darkshire and Westfall?
faq.answer: Knowing Stormwind's court has stalled, Solomon attempts to form mutual aid pacts with neighboring Alliance settlements. Unfortunately, Westfall is paralyzed by the Defias Brotherhood and Darkshire is overwhelmed by the undead and feral beasts, leaving neither able to spare a single defender.

angles.text: Solomon's political abandonment illustrates the deep fractures within the Alliance of Stormwind, showing how outer provinces are left entirely to rely on freelance heroes.
For human travelers, speaking to Solomon reveals the grim state of the kingdom outside the safety of Elwynn Forest's inner borders.
Dwarven visitors may find a tragic connection in Solomon's history, as Ironforge's effort to answer his distress call resulted in the ambush and capture of Princess Moira Bronzebeard.
